summary: Legacy VB6 application with critical modernization needs. High security and maintainability risks due to outdated technology stack, but well-structured agent system for modernization support.

hotspots.reason: Direct ADO usage with potential SQL injection vulnerabilities and no connection pooling

provenance.evidence: Reference to Microsoft ActiveX Data Objects 2.0 Library

hotspots.reason: Legacy VB6 authentication with no modern security standards (OAuth, JWT, MFA)
MDI forms with tight coupling between UI and business logic, difficult to test and maintain

risks.title: End-of-Life Technology Stack
risks.description: VB6 is no longer supported by Microsoft, creating security and compliance risks

risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: Direct ADO usage without parameterized queries exposes application to SQL injection attacks

risks.title: No Automated Testing
risks.description: Legacy VB6 architecture makes unit testing extremely difficult, increasing regression risk

risks.title: Monolithic Architecture
risks.description: Single executable with all functionality makes scaling and maintenance challenging
